SELECT x.osType osType, SUM(x.count) count FROM ( SELECT os_type osType, SUM(c2s_byte_len+s2c_byte_len) count FROM traffic_ua_statistic where stat_time > DATE_SUB((SELECT stat_time FROM traffic_ua_statistic WHERE entrance_id=1 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 0,1),INTERVAL 1 HOUR) and entrance_id=1 GROUP BY osType UNION ALL SELECT os_type osType, SUM(c2s_byte_len+s2c_byte_len) count FROM traffic_ua_statistic where stat_time > DATE_SUB((SELECT stat_time FROM traffic_ua_statistic WHERE entrance_id=2 ORDER BY stat_time DESC LIMIT 0,1),INTERVAL 1 HOUR) and entrance_id=2 GROUP BY osType ) x GROUP BY x.osType ORDER BY count DESC limit 0,10
